result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would erase the concept of "otherness"—the idea that any being is fundamentally separate, inferior, or unworthy of care. Not just tolerance, but a deep, unshakable recognition that every life, every consciousness, is intertwined with the whole.

No borders, no hierarchies, no violence born from the illusion of division. Just existence, shared.
